title: CBS News delays 60 Minutes segment featuring investigation into El Salvador’s Cecot megaprison
summary: Backlash after broadcaster announces the program, which was due to air on Sunday night, ‘needs additional reporting’ CBS News is facing a backlash from one of its own correspondents, and others, after it cancelled an upcoming 60 Minutes investigation into El Salvador’s brutal Cecot megaprison to which the Trump administration deported hundreds of migrants. The episode of its flagship program was due to air on Sunday night. However, in an “editors note” posted on X , the broadcaster’s official account announced that “the lineup for tonight’s edition of 60 Minutes has been updated. Our report ‘Inside Cecot’ will air in a future broadcast.” Continue reading...
